'''Luma-panels''' were illumination devices used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' had luma-panels installed on the ceiling of the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] which were programmed to dim during combat situations.
